descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
With 25+ years of experience, AROBS delivers innovative software solutions across diverse industries, including Automotive, Aerospace, Maritime, Travel & Hospitality, IoT, Life Sciences, Medical Devices, Fintech, and Enterprise Solutions.
 The position of Quality Engineer is within our verification team that manages testing and verification for medical devices. This role will lead the software verification and validation activities for diagnostics product software. To support these goals, specific systems engineering technical expertise with a rich history in complex system verification techniques, test environments, system integration, and validation is crucial to the successful deployment of our client's products.
 Working with cross-functional teams, you will be responsible for ensuring accuracy, consistency, and robust documentation for the design, development, and testing of software applications embedded in diagnostic and interventional cardiology devices.
 Responsibilities 
Work with design engineering in the completion of product verification and validation
Specify and execute test cases based on analyzed requirements and overall test strategy
Create test documentation, including test specifications and impact testing, and ensure product & process quality as per customer requirements and defined software development guidelines
Appropriately document experiment plans and results, including protocol writing and reports
Review user/software requirements documentation with relevant stakeholders
Apply sound, systematic problem-solving methodologies in identifying, prioritizing, communicating, and resolving quality issues
Provide updates to the management team as required
Ensure close communication and working relationships with R&D, regulatory, quality, PMO, and other necessary functional teams
Responsible for exhibiting professional behavior with both internal/external business associates that reflects positively on the company and is consistent with the company’s policies and practices; build productive internal/external working relationships
Performs other related duties and responsibilities, on occasion, as assigned
 Requirements 
BS degree in Computer Science or a related engineering field (or equivalent experience)
5 years of firmware testing experience, especially in a medical device or similar environment
Understanding of the software development life cycle, verification and validation, and defect processing
Proficiency in C/C++, white box testing, and code review experience
Experience testing physical devices from technical designs, specifications, requirements
Strong English communication skills or excellent documentation skills (highly regulated development environment)
 Plus 
Familiarity with scripting languages; Python is a plus
Experience in delivering products for the Medical Device industry or IVD experience
An appreciation of detailed engineering documentation and sound technical skills
 Locations : Bucharest, Cluj, Craiova
